description: SNISB is Brazil's national dam safety information system, one of the main instruments of the National Dam Safety Policy set up by Law 12,334 of 2010 and managed by the national water and sanitation agency ANA. It brings together data on dams built for multiple-use water storage, hydropower, containment of industrial waste and disposal of mining tailings and sediments, with registration and technical data for following dam safety across the country. Citizens can search dams by name, location or regulator, view a map, follow dam status, read the annual dam safety reports and take training, while dam owners and regulators log in to update their records. Coverage is dams across Brazil under the national policy. Access is free online through the portal, which needed a rendering browser from the cloud. Caveats: no licence or bulk download was seen on the home page, and the fields shown per dam were not checked. Simulation uses: dam and tailings inventory for dam break and flood exposure, and emergency planning downstream of reservoirs. Related records: the US National Inventory of Dams (data-usace-national-inventory-of-dams), the Portuguese large dams list (data-portugal-cnpgb-large-dams-list) and the Romanian dam register (data-romania-rebar-national-dam-register).
